notes: Integration describes repository state, not legal authority.
Staging frontend packages were reviewed separately and were not yet integrated into the mainline release at inspection time.
Every frontend claim is bounded by its claim_ceiling and nonclaims.
assurance_profile is a conservative projection of typed interfaces and checker evidence; it is not an authority grant, maturity score, or replay permission.
typed means a typed carrier or bounded implementation evidence exists; it does not mean the source or legal interpretation is correct.
residual means the relevant population remains explicitly accounted with blockers or unresolved scope; observe_only means a check records evidence without uniform blocking.
not_claimed means this public snapshot makes no frontend-level claim for that axis; unknown means the inspected evidence did not resolve it.
